title: Case
description: A benchmark case: the original problem statement handed to the agent under test. The case carries only the question and optional repository context; it never contains the GT rubric, agent identity, tool policy or cost data (see docs/ai-scoring-design.md §8.1, §9.1). Business version is locked via schema_version.

schema_version.description: Locked business version for the case contract.

question.description: The complete, self-contained problem statement shown to the agent.
